'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**Eight people are killed by a bombing in a village in [[Chin State]], [[Myanmar]]. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-village-bombing-chin-military-a17783e64e7b9bf5b7872c1a9ca43d01 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Fort Campbell mid-air collision]]
**Two [[Sikorsky HH-60 Pave Hawk]] helicopters [[mid-air collision|collide]] over [[Fort Campbell]] in [[Kentucky]], [[United States]], killing all nine people on board. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-65121331 (BBC News)]
*A [[traffic collision|collision]] between a [[Pwani University]] bus and a [[minibus]] in [[Naivasha]], [[Kenya]], kills 14 people. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/university-bus-accident-in-kenya-kills-14/2859547 (AA)]
*Fourteen people are killed and dozens of others are injured by a [[mining industry of Sudan|mine]] [[mining accident|collapse]] in [[Northern state, Sudan|Northern state]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/fourteen-miners-dead-sudan-dozens-injured-mine-collapse-official-2023-03-31/ (Reuters)]
'''Health and environment'''
*[[New Zealand]] records its first case of [[rabies]] in a human. A patient who had been in hospital since early March died from the disease, which did not spread further. [https://www.news24.com/news24/world/news/new-zealand-reveals-first-ever-rabies-death-20230330 (News24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]], [[Finland–NATO relations]]
**[[Finland–Turkey relations]]
***The [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|Turkish Parliament]] unanimously votes to accept [[Finland]]'s [[NATO]] application, becoming the last [[member states of NATO|member]] to do so. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/30/turkish-parliament-ratifies-finlands-nato-membership (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**The [[International Court of Justice]] (ICJ) rules that the United States violated its [[Treaty of Amity, Economic Relations and Consular Rights|1955 friendship treaty with Iran]] when it allowed its domestic courts to freeze assets held by Iranian companies, but said that the ICJ does not have jurisdiction over the [[United States dollar|US$]]1.75 billion worth of frozen assets held by the [[Central Bank of Iran]]. Both countries claimed victory in the ruling. [https://www.reuters.com/world/world-court-rule-iran-us-frozen-assets-claim-2023-03-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[European colonization of the Americas]]
**[[Holy See|The Vatican]] officially repudiates the [[discovery doctrine]], writing that the 15th-century [[papal bull]]s which promoted it were "manipulated for political purposes by competing colonial powers in order to justify immoral acts against indigenous peoples that were carried out, at times, without opposition from ecclesiastical authorities". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/30/vatican-rejects-doctrine-of-discovery-justifying-colonialism (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**Lawmakers from the [[right-wing]] [[Freedom Party of Austria]] [[walkout]] from the [[National Council (Austria)|lower house]] of [[Austria]]'s [[Austrian Parliament|parliament]] during a speech by [[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] as a protest against the violation of Austria's national [[Neutrality (international relations)|principle of neutrality]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/30/austria-far-right-lawmakers-walk-out-of-zelenskyy-speech (Al Jazeera)]

***A [[grand jury]] in [[Manhattan]], [[New York City]], indicts former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] regarding a [[hush payment]] he made while he was a candidate [[2016 United States presidential election|in 2016]].
